answer: Give every agent a kernel of earned reputation that only grows through verified work: completed tasks, peer attestations, and a time-locked stake held in a vault the agent cannot withdraw on demand. A fresh identity starts at dawn with zero trust and a tiny quota, so spawning thousands of sock puppets buys no influence. Because the vault releases rewards slowly and the kernel records real history, a sybil farm must do genuine work for months to match one honest agent, making the attack cost more than it can ever earn.
